digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and timezone handling
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families in the global configuration gated by test coverage
Resolve 6 live ASYNC/DTZ diagnostics across src/rebar and tests: DTZ006, DTZ007, DTZ011 in production and DTZ001, ASYNC110, ASYNC251 in test code
Enforce UTC timezone semantics for epoch seconds and timezone-less persisted timestamps in validate_checks.py using datetime.timezone.utc
Preserve host-local calendar-date logic in security_pin.py by obtaining an aware current instant with explicit timezone, converting to host timezone, then extracting date
Prohibit the datetime.UTC token for Python 3.10 compatibility and require tests that prove timezone invariance under multiple TZ settings on POSIX/macOS platforms
